name: Interior Wood Products LLC
old_description: Since 2010, Interior Wood Products has been the Midwest Region’s most comprehensive source for architectural millwork and select building products. Interior Wood Products’ unique manufacturing capabilities enable us to tailor or custom manufacture any item to ensure that you get exactly what you want. Quality service makes us your partner in your building project.
about:
Interior Wood Products LLC was established in 2010 in Plain City, Ohio. The company operates as a partnership of manufacturing, distribution, sales, logistics, and business management entities, serving the Midwest region with architectural millwork and select building products. Its founders and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The firm both manufactures and distributes a broad line of millwork items, including mouldings, interior and exterior doors, S4S lumber, plywood, stair parts, dimensional lumber, and architectural hardware. Its manufacturing capabilities allow custom tailoring of any item, and daily delivery trucks support on‑site installation and timely product supply across the region.

Customers range from large multi‑family and production builders to custom home builders, interior designers, remodelers, and individual homeowners. The company’s account managers provide selection advice to match project requirements, and its logistics network ensures products arrive at the specified time and place.

Interior Wood Products emphasizes effective cost management, high quality, and customer service as its distinguishing factors, positioning itself as a partner in building projects through custom manufacturing flexibility and reliable logistics. The company cites its unique manufacturing capabilities and depth of industry experience as the foundation of its value proposition.
